content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-10|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms are severely restricted, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-every-detail-you-3|Digital Product]] creators face a significant challenge in setting up online stores that can accept crypto payments. This infrastructure problem is not unique to Zimbabwe; creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and other regions face similar hurdles. The solution lies in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-complete-infrastructure-14|building]] a crypto store on platforms like Cloudflare Pages, which can bypass these restrictions.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to this infrastructure's success is its ability to operate independently of traditional payment platforms. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, creators can host their digital stores and process crypto payments without relying on Stripe or PayPal. This approach ensures that the creator owns their store and its data, with no risk of account suspension or transaction freezes.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, you need to choose the right stack. Stack 01, which includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, can be deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. Stack 02, on the other hand, is a more comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves configuring NOWPayments to accept crypto payments and integrating it with your store's backend. This process is streamlined with the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides complete documentation and source code for all 5 stacks. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, and no KYC or buyer account is required.

Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and your payment pipeline is configured, you can go live and start processing transactions. The first transaction is a crucial milestone, as it verifies that your infrastructure is working as intended. With Stack 02, you can rest assured that your store has been end-to-end tested before handoff, minimizing the risk of errors or downtime.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your crypto store involves optimizing your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and transactions. The Sovereign Blueprint includes a scaling playbook that provides guidance on how to upgrade your store's components, such as switching from GitHub Pages to Cloudflare Pages, to ensure seamless growth. By following this playbook, you can ensure that your store remains performant and secure as it scales.

The most important question a reader would ask is how to build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free. The answer lies in using free hosting platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and integrating them with free backend services like Apps Script or Workers.
